items.title: Global Microsoft outage brings cloud concentration risk back onto brokers' radar
items.summary: A widespread disruption affecting Microsoft 365 apps and cloud services has prompted brokers to review contingent business interruption wordings and waiting periods.

items.title: FCA Issues Warning Against Clone Firm Sterlingconsortium.co.uk
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has issued a warning against an unauthorized entity cloning the details of Sterling Consortium Limited.

items.title: Startup Pinion Gets Regulatory Nod to Acquire Catlin Specialty
items.summary: Pinion US Holdings has secured approval from the Oklahoma Insurance Department to acquire Catlin Specialty Insurance Co.

items.title: FM Research Shows Property Losses Concentrate in Small Fraction of Sites
items.summary: Commercial property mutual FM reports that between 30% and 40% of its gross loss dollars originate from roughly 1,000 locations.

items.title: Vessel struck by projectile off UAE coast, sparking engine room fire
items.summary: A vessel was struck by an unidentified projectile northwest of Ras Al-Khaimah, causing an engine room fire that prompted crew evacuation.

items.title: Broadstone introduces Elements+ employee benefits package for SMEs
items.summary: Broadstone has launched Elements+, a new proposition aimed at businesses with up to 50 employees, combining pension, health, and protection benefits.
